## BinAritOperator type

The upstream BinAritOperator domain: exact named tokens, the Go zero value, and explicitly validated unnamed uint32 values. Constants shared by upstream families retain their shared numeric identity.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type BinAritOperator =
  | 0
  | typeof Add
  | typeof AddAssgn
  | typeof And
  | typeof AndArit
  | typeof AndAssgn
  | typeof AndBoolAssgn
  | typeof Assgn
  | typeof Comma
  | typeof Eql
  | typeof Geq
  | typeof Gtr
  | typeof Leq
  | typeof Lss
  | typeof Mul
  | typeof MulAssgn
  | typeof Neq
  | typeof Or
  | typeof OrArit
  | typeof OrAssgn
  | typeof OrBoolAssgn
  | typeof Pow
  | typeof PowAssgn
  | typeof Quo
  | typeof QuoAssgn
  | typeof Rem
  | typeof RemAssgn
  | typeof Shl
  | typeof ShlAssgn
  | typeof Shr
  | typeof ShrAssgn
  | typeof Sub
  | typeof SubAssgn
  | typeof TernColon
  | typeof TernQuest
  | typeof Xor
  | typeof XorAssgn
  | typeof XorBool
  | typeof XorBoolAssgn
  | RawOperator<'BinAritOperator'>;
```
